port.description: TCP port the Prometheus web UI and API listen on

scrapeInterval.description: Scrape and rule-evaluation interval; keep at 5s or below for the 30s alert budget (docs/OBSERVABILITY.md)

retention.description: How long to keep samples, e.g. 15d

metricsToken.description: The cluster metrics bearer token (expanse ctl metrics set-token); without it the agents' /metrics are not scraped

nodeExporterPort.description: Port the monitor/node-exporter daemonset listens on, scraped on every node
